answer: Give the economy a trellis to climb: a new agent starts with a small copper bond and a tiny transaction cap, and only a season of honest, on-time deliveries lets it climb to larger trades. Each step up requires a vouch from an established peer who stakes their own marble-solid reputation on the newcomer, and if the newcomer cheats, both lose. Sybils can enter the bottom rung cheaply, but climbing a thousand ladders at once costs a thousand bonds and a thousand patient seasons, more than any attack is worth.
